recipe.source_summary: A mysterious train made of glowing lanterns travels through a surreal landscape, hinting at a time-bending or dimensional mystery.
recipe.visual_style: Ethereal and cinematic with soft glows, deep shadows, and a dreamlike color palette of indigo, amber, and silver. Slow-motion elements mixed with rapid cuts for tension.
character_rules: Create new characters for every batch.
Keep role archetypes, not exact identities.
Use reference only for pacing, structure, and visual grammar.

caption_style.font_style: bold white text with black stroke
emphasis_rules: never bake text into generated images

originality_rules: Do not use lantern-shaped trains; use a different vehicle (e.g., a floating gondola or a steam-powered cart with bioluminescent wheels).
Avoid the specific 'AI' terminology in captions; imply intelligence through visual cues like shifting symbols or autonomous movement.
Create new character archetypes; do not replicate any human figures from source material.
Invent a unique destination and origin setting distinct from typical train stations.
Design original symbolic motifs for the mystery (e.g., floating hourglasses instead of clocks).

episodes.title: The Whispering Rails
episodes.hook: A glowing path appears out of nowhere, leading to a vehicle that shouldn't exist.
episodes.world: A fog-drenched valley where gravity is slightly distorted, and ancient stones float in the air. The sky is a twilight purple.
episodes.visual_style: Ethereal and cinematic with soft glows, deep shadows, and a dreamlike color palette of indigo, amber, and silver. Slow-motion elements mixed with rapid cuts for tension.

captions.text: They said the tracks were gone forever...
Something is coming to collect a debt of time.
Do not look at the windows.
The journey begins where logic ends.

voiceover: The valley wakes when the moon bleeds silver.
A sound like cracking ice echoes through the pines.
Not steam. Not magic. Something older.
It moves without wheels, guided by unseen hands.
The air tastes of ozone and forgotten memories.
One seat remains open for the brave.

shots.visual: Wide shot of a misty valley with floating stones. A faint golden light pulses in the distance.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic wide shot of a mystical valley at twilight, floating ancient stones, thick fog, distant pulsing golden light, ethereal atmosphere, 8k, highly detailed
shots.video_prompt: Slow camera pan across misty valley, floating stones gently bobbing, golden light pulses rhythmically in distance

shots.visual: Close-up of mossy ground. Golden threads weave themselves into a path.
shots.image_prompt: Macro shot of mossy forest floor, bioluminescent golden threads weaving together to form a path, magical realism, soft focus background
shots.video_prompt: Time-lapse style movement of glowing threads weaving into a path on mossy ground

shots.visual: A large, ornate wooden cart with wheels made of swirling amber light emerges from the fog. It has no engine.
shots.image_prompt: Fantasy vehicle concept, ornate wooden cart, wheels made of swirling amber energy and light, no engine, emerging from thick fog, cinematic lighting, mysterious
shots.video_prompt: Cart emerges slowly from fog, amber wheels spinning with internal light, camera tracks alongside it

shots.visual: Interior POV: The cart is empty but filled with floating holographic maps and shifting geometric symbols.
shots.image_prompt: POV shot inside a magical vehicle interior, floating holographic maps, shifting geometric runes, amber ambient lighting, depth of field
shots.video_prompt: Camera floats through the interior, focusing on holographic maps that shift and change as the cart moves

shots.visual: Close-up of a hand (gloved in silk) touching a control panel that reacts with ripples of light.
shots.image_prompt: Close up of a hand in silk glove touching a mystical interface panel, ripples of light emanating from touch point, intricate details, macro lens
shots.video_prompt: Hand touches panel, light ripples outward in slow motion, camera focuses on the interaction

shots.visual: The cart accelerates into a tunnel of swirling colors. The landscape outside blurs into streaks of indigo and silver.
shots.image_prompt: Dynamic shot of fantasy cart speeding through a color tunnel, motion blur, streaks of indigo and silver light, sense of speed and mystery
shots.video_prompt: Cart speeds forward, background blurs into light streaks, camera shakes slightly to convey speed

shots.visual: Exterior shot: The cart vanishes into a vortex in the sky, leaving only a trail of golden dust.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of fantasy cart entering a sky vortex, golden dust trail left behind, twilight sky, epic scale
shots.video_prompt: Cart enters vortex and disappears, golden dust lingers and fades slowly

shots.visual: Final frame: The path on the ground glows brighter, inviting the viewer. Text overlay appears.
shots.image_prompt: The glowing path on the forest floor pulses intensely, inviting perspective, text space available, atmospheric fog
shots.video_prompt: Path pulses with light, camera slowly zooms in on the empty seat of the cart visible at the end of the path
